title: Verify: App round loading, empty, error and retry unit tests
summary: App tests with getCurrentRound mocked for success, 404, 500, network and retry
acceptance_criteria: Loading and success states are each asserted with getCurrentRound mocked
Empty (404) and error (500, network) states are each asserted
Retry after a failure reloads the round and shows it
technical_constraints: Fixture roundFixture mirrors backend world.Round; ApiError constructed from the real class; mock Phaser-dependent children as in tests/appHeader.test.tsx

steps.action: vi.mock('../src/api/client', importActual with getCurrentRound as vi.fn()). Reuse the mock setup and Begin click from tests/appHeader.test.tsx. Cases: pending promise shows 'Loading round…'; roundFixture shows 'round-1' and 'OPEN'; reject new ApiError(404,'404 Not Found') shows 'No active round' and no alert; reject ApiError(500,'500 x') shows alert containing 'Round service returned 500'; reject TypeError shows 'Could not reach the server'; reject then resolve roundFixture, click Retry, assert 'round-1' appears and getCurrentRound called twice.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appRound.test.tsx

steps.action: Add direct unit tests of describeRoundError for ApiError with and without detail, TypeError, and a plain string input.
